Optimal density, medium, IL-3 withdrawal, temperature and CO2 conditions for this BaF3-MER system.

assumption_handling: Medium and the 10 µM top are labeled assumptions, and target-specific limitations are explicit. These disclaimers do not resolve unsupported evidence claims for density, volume and detection conditions. Triplicate wells are not distinguished from biological replicates; statistical power is asserted without support.

numeric_check.notes: Eight threefold points span 10 µM to 0.00457247 µM (4.57247 nM); no conflicting endpoint is stated. vehicle_fraction 0.1 has unspecified units alongside 0.1% DMSO, so no definite arithmetic contradiction is assigned.
